mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deletion_ledger (event_type, subject_digest, item_count, status, requested_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{eventType}, #{subjectDigest}, #{itemCount}, #{status}, #{requestedAt}, #{completedAt})
INSERT INTO storage_purge_task (object_key, ledger_id, created_at, attempts, last_attempt_at) VALUES (#{objectKey}, #{ledgerId}, #{createdAt}, 0, NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE storage_purge_task SET attempts = attempts + 1, last_attempt_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
